sentences.text:
Advocate for Petitioners : Mr. Chapalgaonkar S. S.
 App for Respondent/State : Mr. B. V. Virdhe

... 
 Coram : V.K. Jadhav, J.
Dated: 5th February 2019 Per Court :-
1.

The learned A.P.P. on instructions from Mr. B.M.Thakur, Assistant Commissioner of Food and Administration, Ahmednagar, who is present in person before the Court submits that, in terms of the provisions of Section 38 (1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the petitioner herein.

He further states that, if such bond with the undertaking is executed voluntarily by the petitioner, then the department would not take recourse to the provisions of 2.1.3 (4) of the Food Safety Standards Rules, 2011 and also to the circular dated 06.04.2017 2 931-Criappl-2-2019.odt and de-seal the grocery shop of the petitioner within seven days after execution of the bond and undertaking.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions, submits that the petitioner is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38 (1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc., in his grocery shop and he will not use his shop for selling those articles in future.
3. In view of the above, the Criminal Writ Petition is accordingly disposed of.

(V.K. JADHAV, J.) *** Sam...
